newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman upgrades Guinness.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman upgrades Guinness.

text.p: Brokerage Lehman Brothers on Friday upgraded Guinness Plc to a "buy" from "outperform."
The brokerage also raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates to 37.4p from 35.9p and to 39.8p from 38.7p.
Lehman said it was its first earnings estimate increase in five years.

It said it upgraded the stock for the UK drinks group "because Guinness is now putting money back into its spirits brands --- both the UK and US were down in profits because of this and we firmly believe that this will put it back onto a growth track to fully exploit the potential of new markets in the world."
Guinness on Thursday posted an 11 percent increase in 1996 pre-tax profits to 975 million stg, or 34.8p per share. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
